source: nelis (note 89 ; givre, tuyauteries, ouverture notée 4-5 ; manomètres régénérés après trois mains), becom-d (résine, abysses), dmca-solutions (contrôle qualité, EPI), brasserieassur (brasserie, soudure TIG en main gantée).
style: Cinematic editorial photography for a premium industrial brand, documentary realism, {ambiance} mood, palette of {palette}, {lumiere}, tactile {matieres}, set in {lieu} on {saison}, high dynamic range, crisp metal and condensation details, shallow depth of field, fine film grain, photorealistic, no glossy CGI, no HDR look, no futuristic overlays.
interdits: No compliance label, no certification sticker, no stamp, no flag, no company vehicle markings, no dial with numbers, nobody without protective equipment, no posed smiles.
evite: Évite les mains en trop autour des machines et les cadrans chiffrés : scènes vides, détails macro, au plus deux mains gantées d'une même personne.

404.consigne: A single precision-machined part lying slightly rotated next to its own thin pencil outline on blank tracing paper, as if it does not fit its drawing, one small pencil mark circling the gap.
404.evite: La machine en panne ou l'accident.

ouverture.consigne: Wide shot of {sujet} at blue hour, a long run of insulated pipes and steel walkways receding into the distance, vapour drifting across cold floodlights, wet concrete reflecting the light, empty, no people, no vehicles.

section-fond.consigne: Macro photograph, seen straight on, of {matieres}, dense crystals or droplets spreading from the edges, the centre staying darker and almost clear, perfectly sharp across the frame.
section-fond.evite: Les éléments nets au centre, sous le texte.

scene-metier.consigne: Close-up of {sujet} on a steel workbench, exactly two hands in dark nitrile gloves belonging to one person, cropped at the forearms, gauges showing only tick marks and no numbers, generic unbranded hardware.
scene-metier.source: correction nelis g-service-manometres (« deux gants, manomètres à cadran »), dmca home-hero (mains gantées)
scene-metier.evite: La troisième main et le manomètre sans cadran.

lieu.consigne: An empty production hall in early morning light: {sujet}, clean floors, pipes and valves in neat runs, a steel catwalk, no people, no labels.

texture.consigne: Extreme close-up of {matieres} with fine machining marks and a weld seam crossing the frame diagonally, cold side light raking across the surface, background falling into deep shadow.
texture.source: nelis givre sur inox, winsbike plan d'usinage

portrait-generique.consigne: A technician seen from behind in full protective equipment, standing in front of a tidy installation, shoulders and back only, face never visible, no badge, no lettering on the clothing.
portrait-generique.evite: Le visage et les inscriptions sur les vêtements.
